There are authorized to be appropriated to NASA for fiscal year 2007, $17,932,000,000, as follows:
    (1) For Science, Aeronautics, and Education (including amounts for construction of facilities), $7,136,800,000, of which $962,000,000 shall be for Aeronautics. 
    (2) For Exploration Systems and Space Operations (including amounts for construction of facilities), $10,761,700,000, of which $6,618,600,000 shall be for Space Operations. 
    (3) For the Office of Inspector General, $33,500,000.

fable.w: This section only authorizes appropriations to NASA for fiscal year 2007 and divides the amounts among program areas. There is no tempting participation reading: it has no consultation, comment period, hearing, advisory body, rulemaking, or right to sue involving anyone outside the federal government.

qwen_block.w: This section is a standard appropriations provision that authorizes specific funding amounts for various NASA programs and offices. It does not establish any process for consultation, coordination, or participation with entities outside the federal government. The text merely lists budget allocations.
qwen_block.s: There are authorized to be appropriated to NASA for fiscal year 2007, $17,932,000,000, as follows:

opus.w: This section only authorizes money for NASA for fiscal year 2007 and splits it among program areas and the Office of Inspector General. Nothing in it involves consulting, holding hearings, setting up advisory bodies, or taking comments from anyone outside the federal government. The words "Education" and "Inspector General" might look relevant at first glance, but they are only budget line items and create no process for outside involvement.

qwen_chat.w: This section is a standard appropriation clause that authorizes specific funding amounts for various NASA programs and offices. It does not contain any language requiring or recommending consultation, coordination, or input from parties outside the federal government (such as the public, states, or private entities) before a decision is made. The text merely lists budget figures.
qwen_chat.s: There are authorized to be appropriated to NASA for fiscal year 2007, $17,932,000,000, as follows:
qwen_chat.b: Tempting-but-wrong reading: One might argue that because NASA funds external contractors or universities, this implies participation. However, the text itself is purely an appropriation clause specifying budget amounts for internal NASA accounts. It does not describe any process of consultation, public comment, or advisory input from outside parties.
